map_hero_low.png.prompt:
The character: the small grey tabby kitten ninja from the reference image (dark navy ninja suit and headband, big round eyes).

Pose: standing alert with one paw raised, looking up the tower - fresh and eager, tail up

It is shown at about 40 pixels across in the game, so it must read from its silhouette alone: bold shape, high contrast, no fine detail. Full body, seen from the side or three-quarters, feet at the very bottom edge of the picture.
Keep the exact same character design as the reference image (same face, same fur pattern, same clothing).
Draw everything SOLID and OPAQUE - flat filled colour with soft shading. Nothing transparent.
Nothing else in the picture: no ground line, no shadow, no scenery, no text, no watermark.
Style: thick black outlines, flat colors, cute cartoon look, not photorealistic.
Background must be a solid pure green (#00FF00), completely flat, for chroma keying. Nothing green on the character.
Output 512x512 PNG. Save the image as map_hero_low.png in the current directory and report the path.
